verdict.rationale: Together AI documents broad programmatic coverage. Fine-tuning can be launched 'from the console, through the API/SDK, or with the CLI', and dedicated endpoints and batch jobs have CLI commands. There is also a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec with a generated per-endpoint reference, official Python and TypeScript SDKs, and direct REST access. What the evidence does not show is a stated commitment that every UI action has an API equivalent, so parity is shown feature by feature rather than across the whole product. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence of API coverage for account, billing, API-key and organization management, and independent hands-on confirmation that no feature is console-only.
